command_line:
set -eu
mkdir -p busco_downloads
python - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78880349/inputs/dataset_8c0e2a96-ef92-4892-a640-78a0a65823b0.dat" <<'PY'
import sys
import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]) as zf:
    zf.extractall("busco_downloads")
PY
slots=1
if printenv GALAXY_SLOTS > slots.txt 2>/dev/null; then
    read -r slots < slots.txt || true
fi
busco --in "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78880349/inputs/dataset_07e64717-d9d4-4d2a-970d-0c38d0c9fb3f.dat" --out busco_result --mode prot --lineage_dataset eukaryota_odb10 --download_path busco_downloads --offline --cpu "$slots" --force
find busco_result -type f -name 'short_summary.specific.eukaryota_odb10.*.txt' -exec cp '{}' summary.txt \; -quit
find busco_result -type f -name 'full_table.tsv' -exec cp '{}' full_table.tsv \; -quit
test -s summary.txt
test -s full_table.tsv
